body:
## Summary & Context

This PR delivers **P5 (Learning Hub)** in the student journey series (following P0 #98, P1 #99, P2 #100, P3 #101, P4 #102), establishing an honest, interactive curriculum browser across Victorian Curriculum Level 3 and Level 5.

### Key Changes
1. **Interactive `LearningHubExplorer` on `/student/learn`**:
   - **Year Picker**: Allows students to switch between authored Year 3 and Year 5 curricula (reflecting real lesson coverage confirmed in B7).
   - **Learning Area Picker**: Segmented controls for *All Areas*, *Mathematics*, and *English* with real counts of available strands and lessons.
   - **Strand Disclosures**: Strands rendered as semantic `<details>` disclosures with header metadata, lesson counts, and practice counts.
   - **Sequenced Lesson Cards**: Renders lesson titles, intentions, prerequisites, estimated time, and direct actions (`Start Lesson` and `Practise drill`).
   - **Curriculum Codes**: Rendered as recorded (e.g. `VC2M3N01`, `VC2M5N01`, `VC2E5LA01`) with **no false alignment guarantees**.
2. **Honesty & Anti-Fabrication Guarantees (C16)**:
   - Zero lesson progress bars, ticks, "% read", or invented completion figures.
   - Dropped from `/student/learn`: `LearningHubUnitSpotlight` (invented 65% bar), `LearningHubLabSpotlight`, and `LearningHubResourceStrips` (no longer rendered; files remain in the tree for the cleanup follow-up PR).
   - Removed the line 28-30 placeholder chip (`NSW Syllabus Stage 3 · Australian Curriculum`) in `LearningHubHero`.
   - Neutralized line 79 of `LessonCheckSection.tsx`: replaced hardcoded Level 3 claim with `"Every practice question is verified with worked solutions."`
3. **Route Migration to `StudentPortalShell`**:
   - Upgraded `/student/learn/english/page.tsx` and `/student/learn/mathematics/page.tsx` from legacy `StudentShell` to `StudentPortalShell active="learn"`.
   - Upgraded `/student/learn/lessons/[code]/page.tsx` to `StudentPortalShell active="learn"`, rendering full lesson components (intention, success criteria, idea, worked examples, common trap, check-in practice).
4. **Resilience & State Handling**:
   - Added `src/app/student/learn/loading.tsx` route loading skeleton (`role="status"`).
   - Added `src/app/student/learn/error.tsx` error boundary (`role="alert"` with retry).
   - Honest empty states for unauthored year levels and filter mismatches.
   - Distinct guidance for first visit (student with no attempts) vs returning students.
5. **Verification**:
   - Added 10 unit tests in `src/tests/components/learning-hub.test.tsx`.
   - Full student suite (41/41 tests) passing.
   - Typecheck, ESLint, `validate:questions`, and `questions:validate-ledger` passing clean.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

…lesson sections (P5)

- Replaces Stitch mock placeholder on /student/learn with LearningHubExplorer:
  - Year Level picker supporting authored Year 3 and Year 5 curricula
  - Learning Area picker (All Areas, Mathematics, English)
  - Strands rendered as disclosures with sequenced lesson lists
  - Curriculum codes displayed as recorded with no false alignment guarantees
  - Honest empty states for unauthored year levels and filter mismatches
  - First-visit vs returning guidance without fabricated progress metrics
- Drops unrendered mock components from /student/learn (UnitSpotlight 65% bar,
  LabSpotlight, ResourceStrips) and removes placeholder hero chip
- Migrates /student/learn/english, /student/learn/mathematics, and
  /student/learn/lessons/[code] to StudentPortalShell
- Neutralizes LessonCheckSection to remove hardcoded Level 3 alignment claim
- Adds route loading skeleton (loading.tsx) and error boundary (error.tsx)
- Adds 10 component tests in src/tests/components/learning-hub.test.tsx
